'''M3-8Z''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent as a courier by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] Officer [[Deena Riss]] to help her enlist the services of the Republic strike force regarding [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]. The droid could be found at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], [[Carrick Station]] and [[Giant's Spear]] mesa on [[Makeb]]
